# chronicle-workflow-miner

Mines local Chronicle-style Codex history, recent sessions, memories, archive records, and existing asset inventories for repeated manual workflows, then converts only high-confidence reusable patterns into skills, routing updates, custom subagent candidates, automation candidates, or skip decisions.

- Version: 1.2.0
- Source: local/codex
- Origin: local-chronicle-derived
- Lifecycle: iterative-local
- Target: ~/codex vendor skill
